This is a proactive adjustment of the agent's in-game behavior to influence the player experience.

In contrast, the evaluation approach used in the 'PokerBench' benchmark is a reactive assessment of LLM performance against a pre-defined rigorous strategy. POKERBENCH evaluates how well LLMs adhere to optimal poker play by comparing their actions and wager amounts against this established standard.

- Models are evaluated in poker against a "Game Theory Optimal" (GTO) strategy (Zhuang et al., 2025).
